kaikki_vikisozluk.e:
تحتضري (form VIII)
# تَحْتَضِرِي (taḥtaḍirī) /taħ.ta.dˤi.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past active subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara)
# تُحْتَضَرِي (tuḥtaḍarī) /tuħ.ta.dˤa.riː/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive subjunctive/jussive of اِحْتَضَرَ (iḥtaḍara) and اُحْتُضِرَ (uḥtuḍira)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
